note: Lintel intent registry for the Meterless Scout Intent engine. 'label' and 'triggers' are implementer additions (UI label, Stage-1 weighted trigger table).

intents.label: General
intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the Reject band. Never routes to tools.
examples: hello
what can you do?
hi there
help
thanks
what is this

intents.label: Violations and repairs
intents.description: Open and past HPD housing code violations: what is wrong with the building, repairs, hazardous conditions.
examples: What violations does this building have?
Are there any open HPD violations here?
what's wrong with this place
Does the landlord actually fix things when they break?
How many hazardous violations are still open?
show me the repair problems inspectors found
Is the building in bad shape?
any class C violations?

intents.label: Heat and hot water
intents.description: Heat and hot water: outages, heat complaints and violations, cold apartments in winter.
examples: Will I have heat this winter?
Has this building had heat complaints?
does the hot water work reliably
Do people freeze here in January?
any problems with the boiler?
Is the radiator heat ok in this building?
how often does the heat go out

intents.label: Pests
intents.description: Pests and vermin: rats, mice, roaches, bedbugs, infestations and extermination.
examples: Are there rats in this building?
any roach problems?
has anyone reported bedbugs here
Is there a mouse problem?
Does the building have pest violations?
how bad are the vermin complaints
Do they bring in an exterminator?

intents.label: Mold and leaks
intents.description: Mold, leaks, water damage, dampness and plumbing problems inside the building.
examples: Is there mold in this building?
Have tenants reported leaks?
any water damage on record?
does the ceiling leak
Are there mildew or moisture problems?
how many mold violations are there
Any plumbing leak complaints?

intents.label: Lead paint
intents.description: Lead paint hazards, peeling paint, and lead risks for young children.
examples: Is there lead paint in this building?
any lead violations?
is it safe for my toddler with lead paint
Has the building had peeling paint violations?
I have a baby, should I worry about lead here?
lead based paint hazards?

intents.label: Owner
intents.description: Who owns the building: owner of record, landlord entity, LLC, management company.
examples: Who owns this building?
who is the landlord here
What LLC owns this place?
Which management company runs it?
who is the owner of record
Who is behind the ownership of this building?
is it owned by a big company

intents.label: Owner's other buildings
intents.description: The owner's other buildings: what else the landlord owns and how those buildings are kept.
examples: What other buildings does this landlord own?
how are the owner's other properties?
Does this owner have a bad track record?
what else do they own
How many buildings does the landlord have?
show me the owner's portfolio
Is this landlord a slumlord across their buildings?

intents.label: 311 complaints
intents.description: 311 service requests and complaints about the building in general.
examples: How many 311 complaints does this building have?
what do tenants complain about here
Show me recent service requests
Has anyone called 311 about this address?
what are the most common complaints
any complaints in the last year?

intents.label: Structure and DOB
intents.description: Department of Buildings records: structural issues, elevators, facade, scaffolding, construction, permits.
examples: Are there DOB violations?
does the elevator work
Is the building structurally sound?
is there scaffolding on the facade
any stop work orders?
Is there construction going on at this building?
has the DOB cited the owner for unsafe facade

intents.label: Building facts
intents.description: Basic facts from PLUTO: year built, number of units, floors, building class, lot size.
examples: When was this building built?
How many units are in the building?
how many floors does it have
Is it a prewar building?
what year was it constructed
how big is this building
What's the building class?

intents.label: Flood risk
intents.description: Flood risk: the 2050s floodplain, storm surge, and flooding at this address.
examples: Is this building in a flood zone?
will it flood here
what's the flood risk by 2050
Did this area flood during Sandy?
Is the basement at risk in a hurricane?
does sea level rise affect this address

intents.label: Noise nearby
intents.description: Noise around the building: nearby 311 noise complaints, loud bars, traffic, quiet at night.
examples: Is this block noisy?
how loud is it at night
Are there noise complaints nearby?
is the street quiet enough to sleep
any loud bars or parties around here?
How bad is the traffic noise?

intents.label: Commute
intents.description: Commute by transit from the building to a workplace the renter names.
examples: How long is the commute to Union Square?
how far is it to Midtown by subway
What's my commute to Downtown Brooklyn?
how long does it take to get to Penn Station
What's the travel time to work at Hudson Yards?
Is the train ride to the Financial District long?

intents.label: Overall verdict
intents.description: Overall judgement: should I sign the lease, is it safe, red flags, a summary of the building.
examples: Should I sign the lease here?
is this building safe
Any red flags I should know about?
Give me the bottom line on this place
Would you live here?
is it worth it to rent in this building
Summarize this building for me
